title: Your first tap after landing starts the sound and the look controls
items: With Tap to enter gone, your first tap on a Home choice, on the scene or on a Navigator control is what lets the town's sound start. On iPhone and iPad that tap is all it needs, with no warnings.
On a computer, a small CLICK TO ENGAGE LOOK tag sits under the crosshair once you are in the town. Click the scene and the mouse takes over looking around; the tag goes away for good.
Phones and tablets never show the tag. They look around by dragging, as before.
